training.selection: minimum validation MSE; exact ties retain earliest epoch
training.shuffle: dedicated generator seeded with run seed; same order in paired runs

historical_phase.A0_A1_epochs_1_3: micro4, host mmap; original metadata retained

training.initial_continuation: A0/A1 resumed from historical epoch3 including original optimizer/RNG; same paired path

execution.effective_concurrency: set after process/GPU/memory/disk checks; reduce concurrency, never batch/precision
execution.shared_control_reuse: only same seed/sensor/data hashes/config/source/environment; copy exact control artifacts and record SHA-256 per experiment
execution.optimization_change: micro4->32; effective32 FP32 preserved; GPU-resident training tensors; old checkpoints retained
execution.cache_dependency: Owned historical runtime cache reused read-only; preserve until no active references remain

evaluation.test_evaluation: predeclared arms, full RR and FR scenes; no post-test hyperparameter search
evaluation.psnr_convention: common.metrics band mean, peak 2047; GF2 absolute PSNR differs from peak 1023 reports

selection.promotion: each candidate independently requires lower best validation MSE than matched A0 at seed42; no arbitrary winner among hypotheses
selection.confirmation: freeze variant; pair A0/candidate on QB seeds43,44; then GF2/WV3 seeds42,43,44 if QB mean validation delta <0 and at least 2 of 3 seeds improve
selection.rr_fr_role: characterize predeclared frozen arms after validation selection; never select checkpoints, tune coefficients or choose examples using test
selection.adoption: joint RR/FR improvement under same conditions and reproducibility; mixed metrics => partial improvement; no automatic baseline replacement
selection.multiple_hypotheses: report every arm, seed and failure; exploratory evidence, no uncorrected significance claim

preservation.remote_preservation: commit/push only on user request; verify recovery and hashes before runtime cleanup

operation.description: 두 공간 전치를 제거해 같은 위치의 PAN·MS 특징을 곱합니다.

results_summary.limitation: A0·A1은 같은 시드·초기값·샘플 순서와 같은 micro batch 변경 시점을 유지했습니다. 같은 조건에서 RR PSNR·SAM·ERGAS·SCC·Q2n과 잠정 FR QNR·Dλ·Ds가 함께 개선했습니다. 단일 QB seed42 결과이며 반복 시드·센서 확장과 독립 holdout은 아직 없습니다. 이 판정은 현재 비교의 관측 개선이며 기준 모델의 최종 채택을 뜻하지 않습니다.
